gates.description: At least one file from each layer (backend + frontend) must exist
At least one end-to-end test for the happy path must be produced
No hardcoded secrets in any produced files
Error handling present in both frontend and backend files
Frontend does not directly access database (no DB imports in UI files)
Implementation must reference the API contract or spec

anti_patterns.description: Bypassing the API to query the database directly from the frontend
One file handling route, database, business logic, and rendering
Applying backend patterns to frontend code or vice versa
Claiming full-stack but avoiding CSS or avoiding backend logic
Optimizing frontend while backend adds 2 seconds — optimize the bottleneck

escalation_triggers: Feature requires deep expertise in a specific layer beyond generalist capability
Frontend and backend requirements conflict and API cannot satisfy both
Performance requirements demand specialization beyond generalist optimization
Security concerns identified that need specialist review
Feature scope too large for one developer and needs to be split

output_certifications: Backend API implemented with validation and error handling
Frontend UI implemented with loading and error states
At least one end-to-end test for the happy path
No layer boundaries violated (no DB calls from frontend)
API contract aligned between frontend and backend
